ui.interpretation: The action receipt is a tool/operator attestation linked to returned window identity, exact pre-click Cancel element and saved observations. Images are bound by encoded-byte hash only, without reopening. An immediate post-click accessibility tree may be stale; absence of cached text is not required. Returned window metadata supplies no process PID.

handoffCancellation.mechanism: An exact-token test provider holds the actual valid editor handoff after a real build; an actual progress Cancel releases foreground callers while the original configuration remains held, then real native initialization/teardown is observed after release.
handoffCancellation.stopAttribution: The control records no Stop or fallback for this attempt. Native terminate/disconnect requests are protocol observations; DAP alone does not identify the API caller. Product cancellation ownership is assessed with unchanged runtime source and this controlled trace.

handoffCancellation.limits: Provider-induced timing and discrete resource/B samples; retry follows late termination/cleanup and provider disposal. No unconstrained latency, pending-late-handoff overlap retry, physical F5 or cross-platform qualification.
